title: Open Agents Self-Hosted Fork (rmind-agents)
summary: Fork vercel-labs/open-agents to remove dependence on @vercel/sandbox and @vercel/workflow, swap the AI SDK ToolLoopAgent for the pi-coding-agent SDK so the system can route per-turn across OpenCode Go / Codex OAuth / Anthropic, and prepare deployment to agents.rmind.us via Vercel proxy + Cloudflare Tunnel + a home rack.

stories.title: Workspace, branch, and PRD
acceptanceCriteria: Fork rmind-agents exists under j8ckfi on GitHub with upstream remote pointing at vercel-labs/open-agents
Branch rmind/self-hosted-fork is checked out locally at C:/Users/Jack/projects/rmind-agents
.omc/prd.json exists with task-specific acceptance criteria (no boilerplate)
.omc/progress.txt initialized with the recon summary

stories.title: LocalDockerSandbox base image
acceptanceCriteria: packages/sandbox/docker/Dockerfile exists and installs Node 20+, Bun, pnpm, Python 3.12, git, curl, ripgrep, fd, jq, build-essential, ca-certificates
Dockerfile creates a non-root user `agent` and sets WORKDIR to /workspace
packages/sandbox/docker/build.sh exists and tags the image as ${SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE:-open-agents-sandbox:base}
Dockerfile does not COPY any host secrets and does not bake in tokens

stories.title: LocalDockerSandbox implements Sandbox interface
acceptanceCriteria: packages/sandbox/local-docker/sandbox.ts exports class LocalDockerSandbox implementing every method declared on Sandbox in packages/sandbox/interface.ts (readFile, writeFile, stat, access, mkdir, readdir, exec, execDetached, stop, extendTimeout, snapshot, getState, plus workingDirectory/host/domain/type)
Implementation uses dockerode bound to the docker socket from SANDBOX_DOCKER_HOST or default
exec() honours the AbortSignal in options and returns ExecResult with success/exitCode/stdout/stderr/output/wasAborted
domain(port) returns http://localhost:<hostPort> using the rack-side port mapping established at create()
stop() removes the container and any temp volumes; getState() returns a serializable LocalDockerSandboxState

stories.title: Sandbox factory dispatch
acceptanceCriteria: packages/sandbox/local-docker/connect.ts exports connectLocalDockerSandbox returning Sandbox
packages/sandbox/factory.ts connectSandbox dispatches on state.type === 'local-docker' OR env SANDBOX_BACKEND=local-docker
packages/sandbox/index.ts re-exports the local-docker entry points alongside the Vercel ones
packages/sandbox/types.ts SandboxState union includes a LocalDockerState variant
packages/sandbox/package.json gains dockerode (and @types/dockerode) as runtime deps; @vercel/sandbox stays so existing callers still build

stories.title: Pi agent wrapper package
acceptanceCriteria: packages/pi-agent/package.json exists with dependency @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent ^0.70.2
packages/pi-agent/src/index.ts exports runAgentTurn({ taskId, sandbox, prompt, modelSpec, history, onEvent, abortSignal }) returning AgentTurnResult
Internal createAgentSession call wires AuthStorage from PI_AUTH_PATH and ModelRegistry from PI_MODELS_PATH
AgentSessionEvent stream is converted to the existing WebAgentUIMessageChunk shape (start/text/tool-call/tool-result/finish)
Errors during refresh of OAuth tokens surface as a typed AgentTurnResult.error rather than uncaught throws

stories.title: Pi tool adapter from sandbox
acceptanceCriteria: packages/pi-agent/src/tools.ts exports buildSandboxTools(sandbox) returning ToolDefinition[]
Tools cover: read, write, edit, grep, glob, bash, web_fetch — each backed by the Sandbox interface only (no host fs access)
Schemas are TypeBox; AbortSignal is forwarded into sandbox.exec
bash tool maps onto sandbox.exec with the sandbox.workingDirectory as cwd default and respects the spec's 5-minute timeout
web_fetch is implemented out-of-sandbox using globalThis.fetch — agent process, not container

stories.title: Models template + auth bootstrap docs
acceptanceCriteria: packages/pi-agent/templates/models.json includes providers: opencode-go (openai-completions, baseUrl https://opencode.ai/v1, apiKey $OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY), anthropic (api-key), and a placeholder for codex (oauth — managed by pi auth login)

Models listed: glm-5.1, kimi-k2.6, deepseek-v4-pro, qwen-3.6-plus, minimax-m2.7 under opencode-go; claude-opus-4-7 and claude-sonnet-4-6 under anthropic; gpt-5.4-codex and gpt-5-codex-mini under codex
packages/pi-agent/templates/auth.json.example is committed (placeholders only, no real tokens)
packages/pi-agent/README.md documents `pi auth login codex` and `pi auth login copilot` flow over SSH

stories.title: Workflow shim package
acceptanceCriteria: packages/local-workflow/src/index.ts implements the surface used by the web app: getWritable, getWorkflowMetadata, sleep
packages/local-workflow/src/api.ts implements getRun(runId) returning { getReadable<T>(): ReadableStream<T> }
Process-local registry persists each run's chunk buffer in memory and on Postgres so reconnects can resume from a cursor
Existing imports from `workflow` and `workflow/api` resolve to the shim via tsconfig paths or workspace alias
No code path on the rack reaches @vercel/workflow at runtime (verified by grep on the built output / tsconfig path)

stories.title: Wire pi agent runner into web app
acceptanceCriteria: apps/web/app/workflows/chat.ts gates between the existing ToolLoopAgent path and a new pi-agent path via env AGENT_BACKEND=pi|tool-loop (default pi when PI_MODELS_PATH is set)
Pi path constructs sandbox via connectSandbox, then calls runAgentTurn with the chat history converted to pi message format
UIMessageChunk events from pi reach writable.getWriter().write(part) in the same shape the existing UI consumes
Cancellation via abortController propagates to the pi session and to sandbox.exec
Compile passes with bun run typecheck on apps/web

stories.title: Docker Compose for the rack
acceptanceCriteria: deploy/rack/docker-compose.yml exposes services: web (Next.js), postgres, cloudflared
web service mounts /var/run/docker.sock so it can spawn sandbox containers, mounts /data/pi for auth.json and models.json, and reads env from .env
postgres service has a named volume and exposes port 5432 internal-only
cloudflared service uses image cloudflare/cloudflared:latest and reads token/config from env

deploy/rack/.env.example lists every required variable from spec §6 (POSTGRES_URL, JWE_SECRET, ENCRYPTION_KEY, GITHUB_APP_ID, GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID, GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET, OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PI_AUTH_PATH, PI_MODELS_PATH, SANDBOX_DOCKER_HOST, SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE)

stories.title: Vercel proxy project
acceptanceCriteria: deploy/vercel/next.config.ts rewrites all dynamic routes (`/api/:path*`, `/_next/data/:path*`, `/`, `/dashboard/:path*`, etc.) to ${RACK_TUNNEL_ORIGIN}
deploy/vercel/vercel.json sets framework Next.js, build/install commands, and env scoping; production target is agents.rmind.us
deploy/vercel/app/api/github/app/callback/route.ts re-implements the callback by forwarding to the rack with the original query string
deploy/vercel/package.json declares Next 15 minimal deps and a `vercel-build` script
deploy/vercel/README.md states the manual Vercel CLI steps the user must run

stories.title: Cloudflare tunnel template
acceptanceCriteria: deploy/cloudflared/config.template.yml maps hostname agents.rmind.us → http://web:3000 with WS upgrade enabled
deploy/cloudflared/README.md documents the three-step flow: cloudflared tunnel create rmind-agents, DNS route via cloudflared tunnel route dns, drop credentials.json into deploy/cloudflared/
Heartbeat / 100s idle timeout mitigation is documented (agent must emit ping every 30s)

stories.title: Deployment runbook + .env.example
acceptanceCriteria: DEPLOYMENT.md at repo root walks through every prerequisite the user must satisfy: Docker Desktop running, GitHub App registration, Vercel auth + project, Cloudflare account + tunnel, DNS for rmind.us, API keys, pi auth login over SSH
DEPLOYMENT.md states explicitly which steps the agent automated and which require user action
.env.example committed at repo root with the same variable list as deploy/rack/.env.example
DEPLOYMENT.md includes a smoke-test checklist (login, create task, see PR)

stories.title: Type check + commits
acceptanceCriteria: All new TypeScript files pass tsc --noEmit (or bun run typecheck if dependencies install) on the packages they belong to — at minimum the file set is internally type-consistent
Each phase committed as a discrete commit on rmind/self-hosted-fork with a message referring to the spec section
Final commit pushed to origin/rmind/self-hosted-fork on j8ckfi/rmind-agents
